comply.rules_status: STARTER RULES - UNVERIFIED. Not legal advice; confirm each item with counsel / customs broker.

items.title: Confirm HS classification and duty rates
items.description: Duty and import conditions depend on the exact tariff line. A wrong HS code changes duty and can trigger penalties.
items.action: Have a customs broker (CHA) confirm the 8-digit HS code and current BCD/SWS/IGST for each SKU.

items.title: Check India-Japan CEPA preferential duty
items.description: Japanese-origin goods may qualify for reduced BCD under the CEPA if origin rules are met and a certificate of origin is issued.
items.action: Check CEPA schedule for your HS lines and set up certificate-of-origin issuance in Japan.
items.source_hint: India-Japan CEPA tariff schedule; Japan certificate of origin issuers

items.title: Register trademarks / IP in India
items.authority: Controller General of Patents, Designs & Trade Marks
items.description: Trademark rights are territorial. Filing before sharing brand or technical details with partners reduces squatting and leakage risk.
items.action: File trademark applications in India before signing distributor / JV / manufacturing agreements.

items.title: Partner due diligence
items.description: Verify company status, directors, litigation and GST standing before committing to a partner.
items.action: Run MCA director/charge checks, eCourts litigation search, GST filing status; cross-check with the Match module's trust report.

items.title: Distributor agreement terms and importer of record
items.description: Agree who is importer of record, Incoterms, territory/exclusivity, pricing control, warranty handling and termination.
items.action: Draft the distribution agreement with India-qualified counsel; settle importer-of-record and Incoterms explicitly.

items.title: Importer-Exporter Code (IEC)
items.description: Whoever acts as importer of record generally needs an IEC. For a distributor model this is usually the Indian distributor.
items.action: Obtain an IEC for the importer of record (your Indian entity, or confirm the distributor holds one).

items.title: Customs clearance setup
items.description: Imports are cleared by filing a Bill of Entry, normally via a customs broker.
items.action: Appoint a customs broker (CHA); prepare invoice, packing list, bill of lading and certificate of origin.

items.title: Check BIS certification / Quality Control Orders
items.description: Certain electronics and electrical products must be BIS-registered or certified before import or sale.
items.action: Check whether your HS lines or product type fall under BIS CRS or a Quality Control Order.
items.source_hint: BIS CRS product list; DPIIT QCO notifications

items.title: Permanent-establishment exposure
items.description: Staff, agents or fixed places in India acting for the Japanese company can create taxable presence even without an Indian entity.
items.action: Review travelling-staff and agency arrangements against the India-Japan tax treaty.

items.title: E-waste EPR registration
items.description: Importers/producers of listed electrical and electronic equipment may need EPR registration under the E-Waste (Management) Rules.
items.action: Check whether your products are listed equipment; register on the CPCB EPR portal if so.

phrase_hits.perceived_by_listener: A positive signal, close to a yes: the deal is moving forward.
phrase_hits.actual_meaning: Polite acknowledgement. Often a deferral and sometimes a soft no; the real answer depends on internal approval.

phrase_hits.speaker: japanese
phrase_hits.perceived_by_listener: They are weighing it and will come back with an answer soon.
phrase_hits.actual_meaning: No commitment. It may mean the proposal is unlikely to proceed, or that consensus has not formed yet.

risks.issue: Phrase: '前向きに検討します' (literal: 'We will consider it positively.')
risks.why: Likely read by partner as: 'A positive signal, close to a yes: the deal is moving forward.'. Actual intent: 'Polite acknowledgement. Often a deferral and sometimes a soft no; the real answer depends on internal approval.'. Coaching: Say what is being decided, by whom, and by when. Ask for the one thing that would help the decision.

risks.issue: Phrase: '検討します' (literal: 'We will consider it.')
risks.why: Likely read by partner as: 'They are weighing it and will come back with an answer soon.'. Actual intent: 'No commitment. It may mean the proposal is unlikely to proceed, or that consensus has not formed yet.'. Coaching: Give a realistic timeline and name the next step, so silence is not misread as agreement or rejection.
